description: Scaffold a new Next.js web application with `npx create-next-app@<latest>` driven entirely by explicit flags (TypeScript, App or Pages Router, ESLint, Tailwind or CSS Modules, `src/`, `@/*` alias, package manager, React Compiler off, Cache Components on or off, AGENTS.md — saved create-next-app preferences can never leak in), or bring an existing Next.js app up to this catalog's toolchain, then post-process it — `0.1.0-dev.0` version, the shared npm script names the workflows skill calls (`lint` = ESLint flat config with `eslint-config-next` since `next lint` is gone, `format`/`format:check` = Prettier, `typecheck` = `next typegen && tsc --noEmit`, `test`/ `coverage` = Vitest + React Testing Library + jsdom with an 80% v8 threshold and lcov at `coverage/lcov.info`, `test:e2e` = Playwright against the production build, `build`, `start`, `docs` = TypeDoc), `output: 'export'` with `basePath` from `PAGES_BASE_PATH` for GitHub Pages or a server build (`output: 'standalone'` plus a non-root multi-stage `Dockerfile` with a health-check route when the image is distributed), a tested sample feature that follows the `iru-nextjs-code-one-task` references (async Server Component page with a `server-only` data layer, Client Component leaf, Server Action with Zod validation and an auth stub, Route Handlers, metadata, `loading`/`error`/`not-found`, all adapted to static export or the Pages Router), per the catalog's UI contract a `.ui-quality.yml` at the repository root and — with `e2e: playwright` — a Playwright component-testing project against a standalone Vite component gallery (Playwright's built-in `mount()` fixture, `next/link`/`next/navigation`/`next/image` stand-ins), `@axe-core/playwright`, the shared `e2e/support/ui-screenshots.ts` helper, and specs capturing `.ui-screenshots/component/LikeButton/` and `.ui-screenshots/screen/Home/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark with an accessibility check, and `sonar-project.properties` when Sonar is enabled. Invoke as `/iru-setup-nextjs-web`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `app-name`, `description`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `open-source`, `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/`sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `router` (`app`/`pages`), `output` (`server`/`static`), `cache-components` (`yes`/`no`), `styling` (`tailwind`/`css-modules`), `e2e` (`playwright`/`none`), `distribution` (`none`/`internal`), `docs-tool` (`typedoc`/`none`), `agents-md` (`yes`/`no`), `package-manager` (`npm`/`pnpm`/`yarn`), `node-version`, `visibility`, `ci`, `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`, default `enforce`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`), `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — and asks whatever `args` didn't resolve. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating an existing app and, for every artifact it owns that already exists, asks Update / Keep as is / Replace (or Stop). Use whenever a repository needs a Next.js app bootstrapped with its full test/lint/e2e/deploy toolchain from this house template, instead of running `create-next-app` and wiring the rest by hand.
